Subject: MAP & Security Runway — OliveBank evaluation

Jasmine,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We're excited to evaluate Redwood for our internal document redaction and routing use cases. Attached is a rough mutual action plan (MAP) we sketched for the evaluation and close timeline. Before we circulate to legal, we need clarity on a few security gates so we can map internal stakeholders and set realistic sign-off dates: 

- DPA: We need to understand Redwood's position on data retention carveouts for regulated archives. OliveBank policy requires some transaction logs to be retained up to 7 years; we want to confirm whether that is compatible or requires an exception.
- SIG/CAIQ: Can you map the evidence your team will provide vs. what we need to produce internally? A workbook or index would help.
- SOC 2: We need the latest attestation and any attestation scope notes (subservice orgs, exclusions).
- Deployment: We may need a private VPC option for staging; please call that out in the MAP if available.

Attached: MAP_OliveBank_draft_v1.pdf (sketch).

Can we aim for an internal security review sprint the week of Jun 12 and target a decision by Jun 30? That would align with our procurement window.

Appreciate a brief point-by-point reply so I can circulate to Legal and Infosec.

Best,
Alice Larson
Head of Digital Operations
OliveBank

Hi Alice — great to hear and thanks for the clear list. I pulled together the immediate artifacts and a proposed gating timeline; answers inline below plus attachments.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- DPA / retention: Redwood supports configurable retention windows per data class. We commonly support retention up to 7 years for archived transaction logs when customers request it, but that requires the DPA to include an archival retention exception and an approved controls assessment from Legal/Compliance. I flagged this to Contracts and included suggested DPA language in the MAP (see MAP_OliveBank_draft_v1.pdf updated notes).
- SIG/CAIQ: We'll provide a completed CAIQ matrix + evidence index. To avoid back-and-forth, our security team prefers to deliver an evidence workbook (SIG-answers-olivebank.xlsx) that maps each control to the supporting artifact (e.g., config screenshots, policy docs, SOC2 report section).
- SOC 2: Attached: SOC2_Attestation_2027.pdf (AICPA report + scope note). This covers our hosted offerings; Dedicated and Private have overlapping controls—I'll call out any scope differences in the evidence index.
- Private/VPC staging: Available. We can include a staging private deployment line item in the MAP with an ETA of 10 business days post contract signature for provisioning (if Dedicated/Private is selected).

Proposed security gating timeline (draft):
1) Jun 12–16: Evidence intake sprint (OliveBank security team + Redwood). We deliver SOC2, CAIQ matrix, and evidence workbook by Jun 12.
2) Jun 19–23: OliveBank review + questions; Redwood triage and evidence uploads.
3) Jun 26: Final redlines on DPA and retention language.
4) Jun 30: Target acceptance (go/no-go for procurement team).

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_2027.pdf; I also attached an updated MAP with suggested DPA language notes (MAP_OliveBank_draft_v1.pdf).

Next step: can you confirm the list of OliveBank reviewers (Legal, InfoSec, Data Governance) and whether the archive-retention exception needs board/legal sign-off? If so, we'll add an explicit approval milestone.

Thanks — I can jump on a 30-min sync tomorrow if helpful.

— Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Alice — thanks for the quick follow-up and the specific asks. Short answers and concrete next steps below.

1) Retention exception / annex: Yes — Redwood can accept a records-retention annex in the DPA to permit a 7-year archival window for a narrowly scoped transaction log class. We will require: (a) binding legal approval from OliveBank's C-suite, (b) the annex to enumerate the data class and access controls, and (c) a controls attestation cadence (annual evidence upload). I've added proposed annex language to the MAP (see attached MAP_Final_olivebank_v2.pdf).

2) Evidence for archived data: Redwood will retain:
   - encryption-at-rest metadata and key-management references,
   - immutable access logs (read-only exportable),
   - deletion and retention workflow runbooks (how we execute purge/archival actions).
   These items will be listed in SIG-answers-olivebank.xlsx and mapped to CAIQ control IDs.

3) SIG workbook: The workbook will label each row as "vendor" or "customer" deliverable. For anything marked "customer-provided" we'll include a clear example/template so your team doesn't have to guess the expected format.

4) Private staging + SOC2 scope: Private (VPC) staging is supported. SOC2 attestation covers our hosted control environment; for Private/Dedicated we provide a scope note and a supplement of controls mapping. If OliveBank requires an expanded attestation, we can provide a supplementary control letter for the private environment — typically sufficient for procurement in our experience.

Attachments: SIG-answers-olivebank.xlsx (initial mapping), MAP_Final_olivebank_v2.pdf (MAP with annex language and milestone dates).

Next steps (action items):
- Jun 6: OliveBank to share reviewer list + legal contact (Alice).
- Jun 12: Evidence intake session (OliveBank security + Redwood security). Meeting invite to follow.
- Jun 26: Target for DPA redlines to be exchanged.
- Jun 30: Acceptance target for procurement.

If you want a 30-minute alignment before Jun 12 to walk through the SIG workbook and retention annex, I'm available tomorrow morning PDT.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this across the finish line.
